theme: split an orchard so every inspector counts equal ripeness
title: Orchard Ledger: Splitting Rows for Equal-Ripeness Inspectors
strategies: trivial: reproduce the checker's own reference partition (consecutive-position blocks) -- ignores every test, scores the calibration floor
greedy: round-robin plots by natural tree position (no number theory) -- strong on row/window tests, mediocre-but-not-catastrophic on graft (log-index) tests

strong: hybrid coset-skeleton + interval-shim -- group trees by discrete-log index modulo a finer skeleton M = k * lcm(conflicting graft divisors), then merge D consecutive log-index residues per plot; this restores perfect graft balance on divisors that would break a plain 'index mod k' coset while keeping row balance via the discrete log's natural-position pseudorandomness
invalid: dump everything into one plot -- violates prescribed plot sizes, must score 0
